description: This file defines classes and templates for managing graphics buffers, including local, shared, client, and server buffer types with synchronization and memory mapping features. It is part of a graphics buffer management system within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: LocalBufferType
classes.description: Template class for local graphics buffer with iterator support, managing buffer planes and synchronization.

classes.name: SharedBufferType
classes.description: Template class for shared graphics buffer with shared memory mapping, synchronization, and inter-process communication.

classes.name: ClientBufferType
classes.description: Derived class for client-side buffer management, handling buffer requests and status updates.

classes.name: ServerBufferType
classes.description: Derived class for server-side buffer management, handling buffer rendering, publishing, and synchronization.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Method to acquire access to the buffer, returning an iterator if successful.

methods.name: Relinquish
methods.description: Method to release the buffer lock.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the buffer.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the buffer.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Returns the pixel format of the buffer.

methods.name: Modifier
methods.description: Returns the modifier indicating pixel arrangement.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the data type of the buffer.

methods.name: Planes
methods.description: Returns the number of planes in the buffer.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads buffer descriptors into the buffer object.

methods.name: Rendered
methods.description: Marks the buffer as rendered and signals via eventfd.

methods.name: Published
methods.description: Marks the buffer as published and signals via eventfd.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Requests buffer access or state change.

methods.name: Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the handle to the buffer descriptor.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Returns the resource handle for polling or event handling.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Returns the event mask for polling.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles events for the resource, updating buffer state accordingly.
